facts.text: The library lists free accessible parking at the Latonia branch. Bay locations, surfaces and the route to a visitor door are not described.

facts.text: The branch is in Latonia Commerce Center off Winston Avenue, adjacent to Ritte’s Corner. The library says it is on a bus line, without naming a current route, stop or boarding-to-door connection.

The branch will be situated at the Latonia Commerce Center, which also houses the Enzweiler Building Institute, Big Bob’s Flooring Outlet, Dollar General and Fairhaven Thrift Store. It is situated behind McDonald’s.

facts.text: The branch lists one mid-sized meeting room and two smaller study rooms for individual or group reservation and use. Room capacity, noise isolation and booking conditions should be confirmed with the library.
